title: Welcome to the Study
body: This tool lets you explore a high-dimensional Pareto frontier of investment portfolios. Each solution is financially optimal, meaning improving one objective (e.g. return) always requires a trade-off on another (e.g. risk). Your goal is to navigate these trade-offs. Tutorial (~5 min)  →  Tasks (20–25 min)  →  Questionnaire (1–2 min) A reminder will appear once 5 minutes of the tutorial have passed. You can pause the timer at any time by clicking the pause button in the top right corner. During the tasks you will use either the full dashboard with all visualisation features, or a reduced benchmark version with a limited chart set. DISCLAIMER: All data in this study is entirely synthetic and should not be taken as investment advice.
